title: Trump's 50% tariffs take effect after US, Canada fail to reach trade deal
description: The tariffs are set to take effect early Saturday morning, after Trump extended a previous deadline by three days.

title: U.S. set to impose 50% tariffs on Canada after failed talks; Canada to match them
description: The U.S. was set to impose 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian products early Saturday. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney countered that Canada would match them "dollar for dollar."

title: Drastic water cuts issued for California, Nevada and Arizona from Colorado River
description: Federal officials announced sharp water cuts for the next two years on Friday for three Western states that rely on the imperiled Colorado River.

title: Canada-U.S. Trade Talks Collapse; Washington Imposes New Tariffs
description: Mark Carney suspended talks and will take out retaliatory tariffs against the United States after days of negotiations to stave off new levies by the Trump administration ended in an impasse.

title: Trump’s 50% tariffs on Canada take effect after last-minute talks fail
description: The 50% tariff will apply to some $20 billion worth of Canadian products, including wine, hockey sticks, and cement.
